game_concept: A adventure race set in The Kingdom – Orchard Lane, the royal orchard lane: the knight must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before thieves can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Orchard Lane: the royal orchard lane
core_gameplay_loop: In Orchard Lane, repeat each round: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before thieves can use it. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the knight ahead. Then check the wave_target value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the royal seal by solving code steps involving wave_target that move the knight forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the royal seal first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Reassign Relay
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reassign Relay' (Week 1 slot 2), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Orchard Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Orchard Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
